G. Main Rudder PCU Solenoid and Electrohydraulic Servo Valves Installation

SUBTASK 22-23-21-020-003 (1) Do these steps to install the solenoid valve [4]: (a) Remove the plugs on the main rudder PCU ports. (b) Lubricate the o-ring [8] with hydraulic fluid, D00153. (c) Install the new o-ring [8]. (d) Install the gasket plate [3]. (e) Install the solenoid valve [4]. (f) Install the bolts [5 ] that attach the solenoid valve [4] to the main rudder PCU. (g) Tighten the bolts [5 ] to 54 in-lb (6.1 N·m) - 72 in-lb (8.1 N·m). (h) Install the MS20995C32 lockwire, G01048 on the bolts [5 ]. SUBTASK 22-23-21-020-004 (2) Do these steps to install the electrohydraulic servo valve [6]: (a) Remove the plugs on the main rudder PCU ports. (b) Lubricate the o-ring [8] with hydraulic fluid, D00153. (c) Install new o-ring [8]. (d) Install the gasket plate [9]. 22-23-21 (e) Install the electrohydraulic servo valve [6]. (f) Install the bolts [7] that attach the electrohydraulic servo valve [6] to the main rudder PCU. (g) Tighten the bolts [7] to 54 in-lb (6.1 N·m) - 72 in-lb (8.1 N·m). (h) Install the MS20995C32 lockwire, G01048 on the bolts [7].

To align it, do this task: Air Data Inertial Reference System - Alignment from the ISDU, TASK 34-21-00-820-802 or Air Data Inertial Reference System - Alignment from the FMC CDU, TASK 34-21-00-820-801. SUBTASK 22-23-21-860-012 (6) Do this task to enter the zero fuel weight: Setting Zero Fuel Weight, TASK 34-61-00-400-801. SUBTASK 22-23-21-740-001 (7) Do the Stall Management Yaw Damper Computer 1 servo test: (a) Push the ON/OFF key on Stall Management Yaw Damper (SMYD) Computer 1 (E3-2). NOTE: SMYD BITE will operate only when the engines are off or when the flaps are up and the airspeed is less than 60 knots. (b) Make sure that the display shows EXISTING FAULTS? (c) Push and release the down arrow key until the display shows GROUND TESTS? (d) Push the YES key on the keypad. (e) Push and release the down arrow key until the display shows SERVO TEST? NOTE: The display will show some warnings. (f) Push the YES key on the keypad. (g) Make sure that the display shows these indications: 1) WARNING! WARNING! 2) RUDDER MOVEMENT 3) RUDDER CLEAR? (h) Make sure that all personnel are clear of the rudder. (i) Push the YES key on the keypad. 1) Make sure that the display shows SYS B HYD ON? 22-23-21 2) Make sure that HYD PUMPS B switch on the P5 panel is ON. (j) Push the YES key on the keypad. 1) Make sure that the display shows FLT CONT B ON? 2) Make sure that the FLT CONTROL B switch on the P5 overhead panel is set to ON. (k) Push the YES key on the keypad. 1) Make sure that the display shows YAW DMPR ENGAGED? WARNING THE STEPS THAT FOLLOW WILL CAUSE THE RUDDER TO MOVE. MAKE SURE THAT ALL PERSONS AND EQUIPMENT ARE CLEAR OF THE RUDDER BEFORE YOU DO THESE STEPS. RUDDER MOVEMENT CAN CAUSE INJURIES TO PERSONS AND DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT . (l) Set the yaw damper engage switch on the P5 overhead panel to ON. (m) Push the YES key on the keypad. 1) Make sure that the display shows ZERO COMMAND? (n) Push the YES key on the keypad. (o) Make sure that the display shows this indication: 1) RUDDER MOVING (p) After approximately ten seconds, make sure that the display shows these indications: 1) YD 0.0 ±0.2 2) LVDT 0.0 ±0.2 3) END ZERO COMMAND? (q) Push the YES key on the keypad. (r) Make sure that the display shows these indications: 1) RUDDER MOVING (s) Push and release the down arrow key until the display shows SWEEP TEST? (t) Push the YES key on the keypad. (d) Push the LSK adjacent to A/T . 1) Make sure the autothrottle warning lights on the autoflight status annunciators (P1 and P3 panels) come on continuously. WARNING MAKE SURE THAT ENGINE START LEVERS ARE IN THE CUTOFF POSITION. IF THE ENGINE START LEVERS ARE NOT IN THE CUTOFF POSITION, THE ENGINE START SEQUENCE CAN OCCUR. Task Description

3. Autothrottle System - System Test

A. General

SUBTASK 22-31-00-740-004 (1) Do these steps for the disengage/warnings test: 22-31-00 (a) Push the LSK adjacent to DISENG/WARNINGS. (b) Follow these instructions shown on the CDU: 1) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 2) Push and release the A/T disengage thumb switch on thrust lever number 1. a) Make sure that the autothrottle switch goes to OFF and the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. NOTE: The autothrottle warning lights are on the autoflight status annunciators on the P1 and P3 panels. When one light comes on, the other light goes out in a continuous sequence of flashes. 3) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 4) Push and release the A/T disengage thumb switch on thrust lever number 2. a) Make sure that the autothrottle switch goes to OFF and the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. 5) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 6) Push the LSK adjacent to PRESS. a) Make sure that the autothrottle switch goes to OFF and the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. (c) Follow these instructions shown on the CDU: 1) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 2) Disengage the autothrottle. a) Make sure that the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. 3) Push the captain's autothrottle warning light. a) Make sure that the autothrottle warning lights go out. 4) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 5) Push the LSK adjacent to PRESS. a) Make sure that the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. 6) Push the first officer's autothrottle warning light. a) Make sure that the autothrottle warning lights go out. 7) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 8) Push the LSK adjacent to PRESS. a) Make sure that the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. 9) Push and release the A/T disengage thumb switch on thrust lever number 1. a) Make sure that the autothrottle warning lights go out. 10) Set the autothrottle switch to ARM. 11) Push the LSK adjacent to PRESS. a) Make sure that the captain's and first officer's autothrottle warning lights flash. 12) Push and release the A/T disengage thumb switch on thrust lever number 2. a) Make sure that the autothrottle warning lights go out. 22-31-00 RYR 043, 044, 056-063, 067-078, 081, 083-103, 111-114, 121-129, 131, 132, 135, 138-169, 174-179, 182-187, 189-203, 205-209, 212-220, 223, 224, 231-236, 239-298, 301-304, 306, 308, 315-317, 322-341, 343, 346-999 b) Make sure that TEST PASSED shows on the CDU. K. Torque Test

SUBTASK 22-31-00-860-013 (1) Do these steps for the torque test: (a) Push the LSK adjacent to THROTTLE TESTS. 22-31-00 WARNING MAKE SURE THAT ENGINE START LEVERS ARE IN THE CUTOFF POSITION. IF THE ENGINE START LEVERS ARE NOT IN THE CUTOFF POSITION, THE ENGINE START SEQUENCE CAN OCCUR. THIS CAN CAUSE INJURY TO PERSONS AND DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT . (b) Do the instructions on the CDU. (c) Push the LSK adjacent to CONTINUE. SUBTASK 22-31-00-740-007 (2) Push the LSK adjacent to TORQUE TEST . (a) Do the instructions on the CDU. (b) Push the LSK adjacent to CONTINUE. (c) Make sure that the torque does not exceed 11 in-oz while the thrust levers are moving. (d) Make sure that the torque does not exceed 17 in-oz while motors are driving the thrust levers against the aft stop. (e) Make sure that the torque on the CDU is within approximately +/- 1.5 in-oz of stable values during these phases of the test: 1) Start of test, no thrust levers movement 2) Thrust levers moving toward forward stop 3) Thrust levers moving toward aft stop. NOTE: 1) It is important that the thrust levers reach steady state torques and stay within +/- 1.5 in-oz of stable values at each phase, this is testing for smooth lever movement free of restrictions. 2) When the thrust levers get to their limits of travel the torque may increase by approximately 3.0 to 6.0 in-oz. 3) The CDU has a 2 second screen update rate, the torque shown may not be consistent with a stable value during phase changes due to this delay. 4) It is not expected that Throttle-1 and Throttle-2 torque reading to be the same value. (f) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX. 1) Make sure that the A/T BITE TEST INTERACTIVE THROTTLE TESTS page shows on the CDU. (g) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX again. (h) Do the instructions on the CDU. (i) Push the LSK adjacent to CONTINUE. (j) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX. (k) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX again. (l) Make sure that the MAIN BITE INDEX page shows on the CDU.

22-31-81-000-801Autothrottle Brake Assembly - Removal ATA 22 · Task 000-801

Task Description

2. Autothrottle Brake Assembly - Removal (Figure 401)

A. General

(1) There are two autothrottle brake assemblies on an airplane. (2) The autothrottle brake assemblies are installed on the autothrottle assembly. The autothrottle assembly is located inside the forward access door.

B. References

Reference Title 22-31-91-020-801 Autothrottle Servo Motor and Gearbox Removal (P/B 401) 76-11-05-000-801-F00 Thrust Lever Angle Resolver and Autothrottle Brake Assembly Removal (P/B 401)

C. Location Zones

Zone Area 112 Area Forward of Nose Landing Gear Wheel Well 211 Flight Compartment - Left 212 Flight Compartment - Right

D. Prepare for the Removal

SUBTASK 22-31-81-000-001 (1) Remove the associated autothrottle servo motor and gearbox. To remove it, do this task: Autothrottle Servo Motor and Gearbox Removal, TASK 22-31-91-020-801. SUBTASK 22-31-81-010-001 (2) Remove the associated autothrottle resolver. To remove it, do this task: Thrust Lever Angle Resolver and Autothrottle Brake Assembly Removal, TASK 76-11-05-000-801-F00.

E. Autothrottle Brake Assembly Removal

SUBTASK 22-31-81-020-001 (1) Do these steps to disconnect the thrust lever connecting rod [6]: (a) Remove the cotter pin [3]. (b) Remove the bolt [1], washer [5], and nut [4] that holds the thrust lever connecting rod [6] to the brake assembly [2]. SUBTASK 22-31-81-020-002 (2) Remove the bolt [10], washer [9], and nut [8] to disconnect the control rod [11]. SUBTASK 22-31-81-010-002 (3) Slide the brake assembly [2] off the shaft [7].

E. Autothrottle Brake Assembly Installation

SUBTASK 22-31-81-420-001 (1) Do these steps to install the brake assembly [2]: (a) Apply grease, D00013 or grease, D00633 to the shaft [7]. (b) Install the brake assembly [2] on the autothrottle shaft [7]. (c) Attach the control rod [11] to the brake assembly [2] with the bolt [10], washer [9], and nut [8]. (d) Install the bolt [1] with its head on the inboard side of the thrust lever connecting rod [6]. (e) Install the nut [4] and washer [5]. 1) Install the cotter pin [3]. SUBTASK 22-31-81-400-001 (2) Install the autothrottle resolver. To install it, do this task: Thrust Lever Angle Resolver and Autothrottle Brake Assembly Installation, TASK 76-11-05-400-801-F00. SUBTASK 22-31-81-400-002 (3) Install the autothrottle servo motor and gearbox. To install it, do this task: Autothrottle Servo Motor and Gearbox Installation, TASK 22-31-91-400-801.

22-31-91-020-801Autothrottle Servo Motor and Gearbox Removal ATA 22 · Task 020-801

Task Description

2. Autothrottle Servo Motor and Gearbox Removal (Figure 401)

A. General

(1) The autothrottle servo motor (referred to as the servo motor) is installed on the gearbox of the autothrottle assembly. (2) The gearbox is installed on the autothrottle assembly. (3) The servo motor and the gearbox can also be removed and installed as a unit. To remove both as a unit, do not remove the servo motor from the gearbox.

B. References

Reference Title 53-14-01-020-801 Nose Wheel Well Access Panels - Removal (P/B 401)

C. Tools/Equipment

Reference Description STD-858 Tag - DO NOT OPERATE

D. Location Zones

Zone Area 112 Area Forward of Nose Landing Gear Wheel Well 211 Flight Compartment - Left 212 Flight Compartment - Right

E. Access Panels

Number Name/Location 112A Forward Access Door 113AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel 114AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel F. Prepare for the Removal SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-001 (1) Open these circuit breakers and install safety tags: CAPT Electrical System Panel, P18-1 Row Col Number Name E 1 C00721 AUTOTHROTTLE DC 1 RYR 006, 007, 013, 014, 018-020 E 3 C01141 AUTOTHROTTLE DC 2 RYR ALL 22-31-91 SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-010 (2) Attach the DO NOT OPERATE tag, STD-858, to the thrust levers. SUBTASK 22-31-91-010-001 (3) Open this access door: Number Name/Location 112A Forward Access Door SUBTASK 22-31-91-010-002 (4) If it is necessary, remove these access panels to get access to the servo motor and gearbox (TASK 53-14-01-020-801). (a) Remove these access panels: Number Name/Location 113AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel 114AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel

G. Autothrottle Servo Motor Removal

SUBTASK 22-31-91-020-001 (1) Remove the electrical connectors [7] from the servo motor [6] and servo motor [13]. SUBTASK 22-31-91-020-002 (2) Remove the left hand servo motor [6] from the gearbox [1]: (a) Remove the bolts [8], nuts [10], countersunk washers [12], and flat washers [9] that hold the servo motor [6] to the gearbox [1]. (b) Remove the servo motor [6]. SUBTASK 22-31-91-020-004 (3) Remove the right hand servo motor [13] from the gearbox [1]: (a) Remove the bolts [14], nuts [17], countersunk washers [15], and flat washers [16] that hold the servo motor [13] and guard [18] to the gearbox [1]. (b) Remove the servo motor [13].

H. Gearbox Removal

SUBTASK 22-31-91-020-003 (1) Remove the gearbox [1] from the support bracket: (a) Remove the screw [4] and washer [3] from the ramp plug [2]. (b) Remove the ramp plug [2]. (c) Remove the bolts [5] and washers [11] from the gearbox [1]. (d) Remove the gearbox [1].

Gearbox Installation SUBTASK 22-31-91-640-001 (1) Apply grease, D00633, on all mating surfaces before you assemble the mechanism. SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-001 (2) Align the gearbox spline on the spline shaft and set the gearbox [1] against the support frame. SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-002 (3) Install the bolts [5] and washers [11] on the gearbox [1]. 22-31-91 SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-003 (4) Align the spline teeth of the ramp plug [2] with the spline teeth of the shaft so that the adjacent ramp faces make contact with each other. NOTE: A properly installed ramp plug will have the end of the ramp plug approximately even with the spline relief on the gearbox worm gear. If the end of the ramp plug is too high or below the spline relief, adjust it as follows: remove the ramp plug, turn it, and engage the ramp plug spline again. SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-004 (5) Install the screw [4] with the washer [3] through the ramp plug [2]: (a) Tighten the screw [4] to 25 in-lb (2.8 N·m) - 35 in-lb (4.0 N·m).

G. Autothrottle Servo Motor Installation

SUBTASK 22-31-91-640-002 (1) Apply grease, D00633, on all mating surfaces before you assemble the mechanism. SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-005 CAUTION MAKE SURE THAT YOU INSTALL THE SERVO MOTOR CAREFULLY . IF YOU DO NOT , DAMAGE TO THE SPLINE SHAFT ON THE SERVO MOTOR CAN OCCUR. (2) Carefully, attach the autothrottle servo motor [6] onto the gearbox [1]. (a) Manually turn the autothrottle servo motor [6] shaft spline to align with the grooves in the gearbox [1] (Figure 402). SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-009 CAUTION MAKE SURE THAT YOU INSTALL THE SERVO MOTOR CAREFULLY . IF YOU DO NOT , DAMAGE TO THE SPLINE SHAFT ON THE SERVO MOTOR CAN OCCUR. (3) Carefully, attach the autothrottle servo motor [13] onto the gearbox [1]. (a) Manually turn the autothrottle servo motor [13] shaft spline to align with the grooves in the gearbox [1] (Figure 402). SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-007 (4) Install the bolts [8], countersunk washers [12], flat washers [9], and nuts [10] that hold the left hand servo motor [6] to the gearbox [1]. (a) Before you tighten the bolts [8], make sure that there is no clearance between the servo motor [6] front plate and the gearbox [1] mounting lugs (Figure 402). SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-008 (5) Install the bolts [14], countersunk washers [15], flat washers [16], and nuts [17] that hold the right hand servo motor [13] and guard [18] to the gearbox [1]. (a) Before you tighten the bolts [14], make sure that there is no clearance between the servo motor [13] front plate and the gearbox [1] mounting lugs (Figure 402). SUBTASK 22-31-91-420-006 (6) Connect the electrical connectors [7] to the servo motor [6] and servo motor [13]. SUBTASK 22-31-91-410-002 (7) If the access panels were removed to gain access to the servo motor and gearbox, install them (TASK 53-14-01-420-801). 22-31-91 (a) Install these access panels: Number Name/Location 113AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel 114AC Fwd Nose Wheel Well Upper Access Panel SUBTASK 22-31-91-410-001 (8) Close this access door: Number Name/Location 112A Forward Access Door SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-003 (9) Remove the safety tags and close these circuit breakers: CAPT Electrical System Panel, P18-1 Row Col Number Name E 1 C00721 AUTOTHROTTLE DC 1 RYR 006, 007, 013, 014, 018-020 E 3 C01141 AUTOTHROTTLE DC 2 RYR ALL

H. Autothrottle Servo Motor Installation Test

SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-006 (1) Make sure that the IRS-L and IRS-R mode select switches, on the P5 overhead panel, are not in the OFF position. SUBTASK 22-31-91-740-001 (2) Do this Built-In-Test Equipment (BITE) test: (a) Push the INIT REF key on the Flight Management Computer (FMC) Control Display Unit (CDU) keyboard. (b) Push the Line Select Key (LSK) adjacent to INDEX. (c) Push the LSK adjacent to MAINT . (d) Push the LSK adjacent to A/T . 1) Make sure that the autothrottle warning lights on the autoflight status annunciators (P1 and P3 panels) come on continuously. WARNING MAKE SURE THAT ENGINE START LEVERS ARE IN THE CUTOFF POSITION. IF THE ENGINE START LEVERS ARE NOT IN THE CUTOFF POSITION, THE ENGINE START SEQUENCE CAN OCCUR. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY INSTRUCTIONS, DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT AND INJURY TO PERSONNEL CAN OCCUR. (e) Push the LSK adjacent to CURRENT STATUS. (f) Do the instructions on the CDU. (g) Push the LSK adjacent to CONTINUE. 1) Make sure that TEST IN PROGRESS shows on the CDU. 2) Make sure that the A/T switch, on the P7 panel, automatically goes back to OFF . 3) Make sure that NO FAULTS shows on the CDU when the test is completed. (h) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX. (i) Do the instructions on the CDU. 22-31-91 (j) Push the LSK adjacent to CONTINUE. 1) Make sure that A/T BITE TEST index shows. SUBTASK 22-31-91-700-001 (3) Do the Servo motor test (TASK 22-31-00-710-802). (a) Push the LSK adjacent to INDEX. (b) Push the INIT REF key on the FMC CDU keyboard. SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-012 (4) Remove the safety tag and close this circuit breaker: F/O Electrical System Panel, P6-1 Row Col Number Name D 13 C00120 WEATHER RADAR RT SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-007 (5) If Inertial Reference System (IRS) outputs are no longer necessary, set the IRS-L and IRS-R mode select switches, on the P5 overhead panel, to the OFF position. SUBTASK 22-31-91-860-011 (6) Remove the DO-NOT-OPERATE tags on the thrust levers.
